title: Filter with IN Operator
description: Find employees in specific departments using the IN operator.

data.text: Write a query to find all employees in the HR, Finance, or IT departments.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Department
FROM Employees
WHERE Department IN ('HR', 'Finance', 'IT')
ORDER BY Department;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: IN is shorthand for multiple OR conditions. WHERE Department IN ('HR', 'Finance', 'IT') is equivalent to WHERE Department = 'HR' OR Department = 'Finance' OR Department = 'IT'. IN also works with subqueries.
